outcome: Association of sociodemographic and obstetric factors with PPD
cohort: 1600 postpartum women who delivered a live born at St. John's Hospital
finding: The prevalence of an EPDS score of ≥13 (indicating probable PPD) was 7.5%, and was significantly associated with a family history of psychiatric illness, history of domestic abuse, delayed initiation of breastfeeding, and female infant sex.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not significantly associated with PPD.
